svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Multi-cloud with a shared identity provider
svg.desc: Multi-cloud with a shared identity provider. 8 components in 6 groups. Connections: Okta to AWS Cloud (SAML); Okta to Google Cloud (OIDC); Okta to Azure subscription (SAML); Amazon EKS to AWS Direct Connect; BigQuery to Partner Interconnect; Azure App Service to Azure ExpressRoute; AWS Direct Connect to Colocation router; Partner Interconnect to Colocation router; Azure ExpressRoute to Colocation router.

text.tspan: Multi-cloud with a shared identity provider
One Okta tenant signs users in to AWS, Google Cloud and Azure; private interconnects meet at a colocation router
